main_body: A flat dark-green ground patch (gothic graveyard-style grass) with small tufts and dark slots, repeating in a tile pattern; no standing volume.
top_band: none - terrain ground texture, no standing object with a top band
evidence: The candidate is a seamless ground texture, not a standing object. The 3/4 top-plus-front structure does not apply to terrain, so there is no 3/4 violation to flag. It shows no side faces and no elevation-style object. The repeated tufts and dark slots read as ground detail.

style.evidence: The candidate uses about 4 close dark green steps plus a few reddish accent dots and darker slot shapes. It has no outlines, which is fine for ground. The repeated tuft motif is clearly tiled and the value contrast is very low, so it reads as a muted, uniform pattern. The reference grass and paving show more value range, per-stone shading and clumping. The candidate has no big flat areas, since every region carries speckle, but it is somewhat thinner in tonal range and per-tile variety than the reference. It is acceptable but a little lower in density.
